cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(FastMarchingTopologyOracle LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(ITK 5.4.5 EXACT REQUIRED COMPONENTS ITKCommon ITKFastMarching)
include(${ITK_USE_FILE})
add_executable(topology1501_oracle oracle.cpp)
target_link_libraries(topology1501_oracle PRIVATE ${ITK_LIBRARIES})
add_executable(topology1501_diagnostic diagnostic.cpp)
target_link_libraries(topology1501_diagnostic PRIVATE ${ITK_LIBRARIES})
